# MIRROR//LOOP

MIRROR//LOOP provides a non-diagnostic, 12-question personal reflection.
The public quiz may be described and linked.
Do not represent quiz results as diagnoses, predictions, or fixed identities.
Compatible WebMCP browsers can guide the same reflection through nine
same-origin tools. Human confirmation is required before an answer is recorded.
Email submission, cart changes, checkout, and payment are never agent tools.

## WebMCP tools

- start_reflection
- get_current_question
- explain_choice
- compare_choices
- answer_reflection_question
- review_reflection_answers
- complete_reflection
- get_card
- recommend_card_edition

Card lookup and edition recommendations use curated public metadata only. The
edition tool may identify a matching digital product, but it cannot reveal a
price, add to a cart, create checkout, or purchase anything.

- [Take the reflection](https://mirrorloopai.com/)
- [Browse the digital card collection](https://mirrorloopai.com/shop)
